## HANDOFF ef6b75ef/129 — owner-side linkage for the graph builder (M1a closed, M1b runtime-only)

Provenance **arena/ef6b75ef**, branch `arena/ef6b75ef-windwings-space-shooter-game-p`, code commit **2c710a7c20c123a65db45ddeca1f18c0807abe02**, CI **40401190233 SUCCESS** on that exact head. Report [129-ef6b75ef-native-owner-linkage.md](docs/apk-analysis/129-ef6b75ef-native-owner-linkage.md); artifact `datas/l3_ef6b75ef129_native_owner_linkage.json.gz` **6357 B / SHA `217f8893799733f1f36c9d73ac93ab0b9ca903ead81501492b9bab89fb85071a`**; tool `tools/verify/owner129.py`; tests `tests/test_owner129.py`.

**New original bytes** (fail-on-miss pinned XAPK cache, XAPK `f5d3c7a1…`, libunity `d827b83e…`), three probes:
- `raw/owner129/probe.json.gz` 13911 B `565e276d…` — run 40399193071 / source `9707d26a5`
- `raw/owner129b/probe.json.gz` 9411 B `1e6e0792…` — run 40399523874 / source `b39baaf17`
- `raw/owner129c/probe.json.gz` 12372 B `778b001b…` — run 40399754616 / source `5076e2fb7`

**M1a — closed by byte evidence.** `node+0x118` is the owner field: zeroed by the node ctor `6ceb88` at `6ceba4` (`stp xzr,x9,[x19,#0x118]`, word `7fa611a9`), and **exactly one** store across all **36 unique captured windows**, `6cef80` `018c00f9`, inside the set-owner wrapper `6cef64` (120 B / 30 instructions; old-owner compare at `6cef6c`). That wrapper has one caller, `6b8268` inside `6b81c4` (73 instructions). The stored value comes from `6b6c40` (33 instructions): runtime id at `[x0+0x19c]` (zero → null), global registry `[0x10e18b0]`, map lookup `38cbb4` at `6b6c74`, fallback `3d8614(id)` at `6b6ca8` (hook `0x111dba0`). **0** RELA addends target `6cf7b4`, `6cef64`, `6cefdc`, `6bba20`, `6b6c40`, `6ceb88` — all direct-only. The second wrapper `6cefdc` (8 instructions) never writes the field; it runs on nodes from the vector at `animator+0x498` (0x10-byte records) after the owner check `6b7ff0` and the node virtual `+0x138` gate `6b8000`.

**Node class.** `6bba20` (28 instructions) allocates `x2+0x1d0` through the original sink **`3c986c`** (align 0x10, tag 0x5e, line 0xab, label `0x12da21`), runs ctor `6ceb88` (37 instructions, base ctor `6d6aa0` of 124 first) and attaches via `572a38` (`node+0x20 = controller`, `controller+0x34++`, `controller+0xac |= 0xC8`). The ctor installs three tables: `10b0f98` (43 slots) at `+0`, `10b1100` = primary+`0x168` at `+0x110`, `10b1130` = primary+`0x198` at `+0x120`; clears `+0x128/+0x138/+0x148/+0x188..+0x1a7`, sets `+0x158=0x4b`, `+0x160` constant, `+0x1c0=0`, `+0x1c8=0`, `+0x3c=3`, and constructs subobjects `6c3dc8(+0x170,+0x110)`, `6a6ff4(+0x1a8)`.

**Entry and graph.** `6b947c` sits at table `10b0c80` slot `+0xf8` with **0 direct BL/B** in the whole-.text scan, i.e. it is virtual-only; it reaches `6b7d58` (191 instructions, rebuild → `6cefdc` per node) and `6b81c4` (73 instructions, setup → `6bba20` → `6cef64(node, owner)`). `6b7d58` builds the graph handle at `+0x618/+0x620`, an output at `+0x628/+0x630` (alloc `3c9298`, 0xe0 B, ctor `6ce464` → vptr `10b0f30`, 11 slots, `+0xdc=-1`), then calls output `+0x28` with the node and animator `+0x108`. Original rodata strings: `0xc0fce` = `%s.Animator`, `0x101411` = `AnimatorOuput`, `0x12da21` = empty.

**Table region.** `10b0a00..10b1900` resolves to **23** RELA-dense tables; the nine touched here total **181** slots: 10b0f98/43, 10b1100/4, 10b1130/2, 10b0c80/35, 10b0f30/11, 10b1240/28, 10b1420/2, 10b1150/28, 10b1330/28. Called slots resolve to real code: node `+0xe0`→`6d017c`, `+0x138`→`6d137c`; animator `+0x50`→`3e079c`, `+0x108`→`6b6ab8`; output `+0x28`→`6ce4fc`; 10b1240 RELA `+0x80`→`6d46a8` (120). Slot counts are dense RELA runs — unrelocated slots are unknown, not null.

**M1b — OPEN, runtime-only.** Missing: the runtime instance id at `animator+0x19c`, the registry contents behind `0x10e18b0`, and the owner vtable; no recovered code installs an owner table. Shape constraints only: owner slots `+0xb0()`, `+0xa8(bool)`, `+0xd8()`, plus list head `+0x38` spliced against `animator+0x540` by `49ffc8`. No class name is asserted.

**M2 — contract only.** The motion object is the return of owner `+0xa8` called with `w1=1` (`6cf80c/6cf810`) stored at `node+0x128` (`6cf814`); null selects the original error path `6cf8f0`; `+0x10` is a count of 0x10-byte records (`6cf8a4/6cf8b8`) allocated through `node+0xc0` slot 0 with `count<<4` and align 8 (`6cf8cc`); builders `b98c98`/`b98db4`/`b99120` receive `(motion_object, node+0xc0)` and fill `+0x130/+0x138/+0x140`. Because the object arrives through a runtime owner slot, every builder input would have to be fabricated — **none of them ran**.

**Execution boundary.** No FDE executed; 8 `not_run` entries name the missing prerequisite for each function (`6bba20`, `6ceb88`, `6b6c40`, `6cef64`, `6cefdc`, non-null `6cf7b4`, `572a38`, `49ffc8`). No heap, no registry, no synthetic owner.

**Local verification.** focused `tests.test_owner129` **24 PASS / 0.016 s**; full `unittest discover` **1835 PASS / 289.771 s** (exit 0); `owner129 --check` PASS; 49 byte-witnessed words; tool+input SHA pins in artifact. Receipts: `raw/l3-ef6b75ef129-verification/{claim.json, ci.json, ci-jobs.json, check.json, local.json, focused.log.gz, full.log.gz}`.

**Review requested.** (1) single-writer argument for `node+0x118` (36 unique windows, word `018c00f9`); (2) owner = registry-by-instance-id vs the 126 synthetic-owner model; (3) 124-lineage reading of `6ceb88`→`6d6aa0`; (4) the `+0x168`/`+0x198` interface-table arithmetic; (5) nine-table slot counts; (6) the M1a/M1b boundary. #27 remains OPEN (M1b owner runtime identity, scheduler/registration/dispatch, clip/clock writers, pose/blend/apply, Unity readback/render). Static-only per 6418032974 / 6418326986; no self-ACK, no merge, no main push; protected3 unchanged.
